desc: Ideation complete – design offline solution with Fenwick for LIS queries.
Implement input parsing and coordinate compression of all A[i] and all query X_i together.
Prepare query list with (R, X, id) and sort by R.
Fenwick tree for range maximum on compressed indices; support point update (max) and prefix maximum query.

Main loop: iterate i=1..N, for each A[i] compute new length using the current prefix maximum of values strictly less than A[i] (Fenwick query up to idx-1), then point‑update at idx with the new length if it is larger.
Answer queries: when current index i reaches a query’s R, do a Fenwick prefix‑max query up to the compressed index of X and store the answer.
Write final code and ensure correct I/O, edge cases, and complexity.
